## Goal
Migrate the journal format, replace scheduler admission, and add provider failover in one release.

## Scope fence
- squatch/journal.py
- squatch/scheduler.py
- squatch/providers.py
- tests/

## Acceptance criteria
- Existing journal segments migrate to the new envelope without losing events.
- Scheduler admission enforces dependency and capacity ordering.
- Provider calls fail over to the next healthy configured candidate.
- Focused tests for all three subsystems pass.

## Verification
```
uv run pytest tests/test_journal.py tests/test_scheduler.py tests/test_providers.py -q
```
